title: SPRINGFIELD SYMPHONY: From the New World
seo_title: Springfield Symphony: From the New World in Springfield, MO
description: The Springfield Symphony Orchestra performs Dvořák's New World Symphony, along with Adolphus Hailstork's Three Spirituals for Orchestra and Mendelssohn's Violin Concerto featuring violinist Fiona Shea. The program also showcases the orchestra's Hellam Competition Winner. It takes place Saturday, March 6, 2027 at 7:30 PM at Juanita K. Hammons Hall for the Performing Arts, 901 S. National Ave., Springfield, MO, with tickets sold only through HammonsHall.com and MissouriStateTix.com.
venue: Juanita K. Hammons Hall for the Performing Arts
